svg.text: Collections console to api: REST, session cookie (request and reply)
Claude Code to mcp: MCP over stdio (request and reply)
Bank feed (simulated) to api: HMAC-signed credit (event or message)
api to Services and tool registry: service calls (request and reply)
api to Orchestrator: reply and payment runs (request and reply)
mcp to Services and tool registry: tool registry (request and reply)
worker to Orchestrator: daily run, reply runs (event or message)
Orchestrator to Services and tool registry: registry in-process (request and reply)
Orchestrator to LLM gateway: prompts, tool calls (request and reply)
LLM gateway to OpenRouter: HTTPS chat completions (request and reply)
Services and tool registry to PostgreSQL 17: SQL in transactions (request and reply)
worker to Mailpit (mailhog): SMTP send once (event or message)
a box inside a service is a module; the cylinder marks a service that owns its data; a dashed box is outside our control
